interface.title: Remove Interface
interface.description: Are you sure you want to remove this PIMv6 interface? This will remove all PIMv6 and MLD settings for this interface.

rpAddress.title: Remove RP Address
rpAddress.description: Are you sure you want to remove this Rendezvous Point address? This will remove all associated multicast groups and prefix-list6 bindings.
rpAddress.descriptionLast: Are you sure you want to remove this rendezvous point (RP) address? It is the last RP address, so this also clears the RP keep alive timer.

pim6.title: Delete PIMv6
pim6.description: Are you sure you want to delete the whole PIMv6 configuration? This removes every PIMv6 interface, RP address and global setting.
